commands.description: Places a copy of a prefab at a world position. Placing the player prefab when a player exists moves that player instead.
commands.name: scene.spawn

commands.description: Fills a rectangle of grid cells (inclusive) with a tile prefab, replacing whatever tiles were there.
commands.name: scene.paintRect

commands.description: Removes an entity from the scene.
commands.name: entity.delete

commands.description: Saves an entity as a new prefab (prefabs/<name>.prefab); the entity becomes its first copy.
commands.name: prefab.createFromEntity

commands.description: Creates or replaces a Lua script (see docs/scripting.md for the API scripts can use). Attach it with a LuaScript component.
commands.name: script.write

commands.description: Creates or replaces a World Bible entry (canon: characters, factions, locations, items, events, lore, style).
commands.name: world.write

params.description: character, faction, location, item, event, lore or style.
params.name: kind

params.description: File name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (empty: made from the name).
params.name: id

params.description: Links to other entries, '; '-separated, each '<type> <kind>/<id>', e.g. 'lives_in location/brookvale; member_of faction/iron-guild' (may be empty).
params.name: relations

commands.description: Adds a named place (a Marker) that schedules can send people to, e.g. herb_garden. Invisible in play. Use a free, walkable cell.
commands.name: scene.addMarker

params.description: Lowercase letters, digits and _, e.g. village_well.
params.name: name

commands.description: Builds a dungeon in a rectangle of grid cells: rooms joined by corridors, walled in, every room reachable, with enemies (more of them further from the start) and pickups. Everything already in the area except the player is replaced. Deterministic: the same seed gives the same level. Pick an area away from what should stay (see the tile bounds).
commands.name: level.generate

params.description: Any number; change it for a different layout.
params.name: seed

params.description: How many rooms to try to fit.
params.name: rooms

params.description: 0-1: extra corridors so not every path is a dead end.
params.name: loops

params.description: Tile prefab for the floor, e.g. prefabs/stone_floor.prefab.
params.name: floor

params.description: Solid tile prefab for the walls, e.g. prefabs/wall.prefab.
params.name: wall

params.description: Pickup prefab (e.g. a potion); empty for none.
params.name: pickup

params.description: Move the player to the start room.
params.name: movePlayer

components.description: A designer-facing name, shown in the Scene Tree and usable from scripts.
components.name: Name

components.description: A ground cell. Collision comes from tiles: a cell is walkable only if it holds a non-solid tile, so empty space is a wall.
components.name: Tile

components.description: Position in world grid units (1.0 = one tile; cell centers are n + 0.5).

fields.description: Grid x; increases down-right on screen.
fields.name: x

fields.description: Grid y; increases down-left on screen.
fields.name: y

components.name: WorldTransform2D

components.description: Movement this frame, in cells per second. Velocity2D + Collider2D marks the player.

fields.description: Cells per second along grid x.
fields.name: x

fields.description: Cells per second along grid y.
fields.name: y

components.name: Velocity2D

components.description: Box used for wall collision, centered on the position, in cells.

fields.description: Half the box width, in cells.
fields.name: halfWidth

fields.description: Half the box height, in cells.
fields.name: halfHeight

components.name: Collider2D

components.description: Which side an entity is on. Attacks never hurt members of the same non-neutral team.
components.name: Faction

components.description: Hit points. At 0 the entity dies (enemies are removed; the player stays, dead).

fields.description: Current hit points; entities start the game with this, so keep it equal to max unless they should start hurt.
fields.name: current

fields.description: Maximum hit points; healing stops here.
fields.name: max

components.name: Health

components.description: Combat numbers. Damage dealt = max(minimum, attack's damage + attack - target's defense).

fields.description: Walking speed in cells per second (the player's).
fields.name: moveSpeed

components.name: Stats

components.description: The area attacks can hit, centered on the position; brief invulnerability after each hit.

fields.description: Half the area's width, in cells.
fields.name: halfWidth

fields.description: Half the area's height, in cells.
fields.name: halfHeight

fields.description: Seconds of invulnerability after being hit.
fields.name: invulnerableTime

components.name: Hurtbox

components.description: A close-range swing: a short-lived hit area `reach` cells in front of the attacker, optionally applying a status effect on hit.

fields.description: How far in front the hit area appears, in cells.
fields.name: reach

fields.description: Half-size of the hit area, in cells.
fields.name: radius

fields.description: How far a hit pushes the target, in cells.
fields.name: knockback

fields.description: How long the effect lasts, in seconds.
fields.name: effectDuration

fields.description: Burn/Poison: damage per tick. Regen: healing per tick. Slow: fraction of speed removed (0-1).
fields.name: effectMagnitude

components.name: MeleeAttack

components.description: Collected when the player walks over it (left alone at full health).
components.name: Pickup

components.description: Blocks movement through the cell it stands in (trees, rocks, crates).
components.name: Obstacle

components.description: Sound effects this entity plays.
components.name: Sounds

components.description: Walks toward a target (the player if none is set) while within range, stopping at stopDistance; collides with walls.

fields.description: Who to follow; none = the player.
fields.name: target

fields.description: Stops this close to the target, in cells.
fields.name: stopDistance

fields.description: Only follows within this distance; 0 = always.
fields.name: range

components.name: Follow

components.description: A named place in the scene, for routines to send people to. Invisible in play.
components.name: Marker

components.description: A way into another scene: stepping into its cell during play takes the player there.

fields.description: The scene it leads to, e.g. scenes/cave.aige.
fields.name: scene

fields.description: The Marker in that scene the player arrives at.
fields.name: marker

components.name: Gateway

components.description: Follows a daily schedule: where to be, and what to do there, through the day.
components.name: Routine

components.description: Someone the player can talk to: pressing E within range starts the dialogue.

fields.description: Who they are in the World Bible (e.g. character/villager): their name on screen, and what 'talk to' quest objectives point at.
fields.name: character

fields.description: How close the player must be, in cells.
fields.name: range

components.name: Talk

components.description: Screen position in scene pixels and draw order. Computed from the world position for characters and tiles.

fields.description: Draw order: higher draws in front.
fields.name: depth

components.name: ScreenTransform2D

components.description: The image drawn for this entity: a texture (or a region of one, like a tileset tile), its size on screen and a color tint.

fields.description: Texture region left (0-1); greater than u1 mirrors it.
fields.name: u0

fields.description: Lies flat on the ground: for art drawn top-down. The image is mapped onto the cell's diamond (width x height) instead of standing upright.
fields.name: flat

fields.description: Quarter turns clockwise of a flat image (0-3).
fields.name: rotation

components.name: Sprite

components.description: Lua behavior (see docs/scripting.md). The script's `properties` table becomes per-entity settings.

fields.description: The .lua file, relative to the project.
fields.name: path

components.name: LuaScript

fields.description: How quickly the camera catches up with the player; higher is snappier.
fields.name: followStiffness

fields.description: A hit never deals less than this.
fields.name: minimumDamage

fields.description: How long a hit sprite flashes red.
fields.name: hitFlashSeconds

fields.description: Off lets the player walk through walls.
fields.name: playerCollides

fields.description: The scene the game starts in (scenes/*.aige).
fields.name: startScene

fields.description: Time of day when a game starts, in hours.
fields.name: startHour

fields.description: Game minutes per real second; 2 makes a day last 12 minutes.
fields.name: minutesPerSecond

fields.description: Always show the clock in play.
fields.name: showClock
